root_cause.text: xfs_alloc_buftarg() in the XFS buffer target setup error path failed to release the acquired DAX device reference, causing a resource leak when allocation/initialization later failed.

In `xfs_alloc_buftarg()`, the failure path ends with `error_lru:` followed by `list_lru_destroy(&btp->bt_lru);` and then `error_free:` followed only by `kfree(btp); return NULL;`. The stated root cause is that `xfs_alloc_buftarg()` must release an acquired DAX device reference on later allocation/initialization failure. In this snippet, the error path frees `btp` but does not call any DAX cleanup/release helper before returning. The commit only changes `kmem_free(btp)` to `kfree(btp)`, which is unrelated to releasing a DAX device reference. Therefore the vulnerable construct is present (missing DAX device release in the error path), and the fix is not present.
